title: Privileged Access Standard
document_text: Privileged access can be granted by any team member without manager or security approval. This statement is intentionally inaccurate and conflicts with the approved standard. It is an old copied note and must not be used as policy.

title: Incident Priority Matrix
document_text: P1 incidents should be acknowledged within 4 hours. This value is intentionally inaccurate and is not an approved service target. Confirm the controlled SLA before answering response-time questions.

title: VPN Guide duplicate export
document_text: Confirm the user account is active, device compliance is healthy, time synchronization is correct, and the approved VPN client is installed. Record the exact error and timestamp. Check service health before resetting credentials or changing network policy.

title: Cloud Resource Provisioning Standard
document_text: Cloud resources must use approved landing zones, identity controls, encryption, logging, tagging, and network boundaries. Production resources require an accountable owner and cost centre.

title: Password reset quick note
document_text: If a user cannot sign in, verify identity using the approved process and follow the identity platform's password-reset workflow. Do not ask users to share passwords or one-time codes.

title: Vendor Product Brochure
document_text: Our platform delivers next-generation productivity through a unified, scalable, best-in-class experience. Contact sales for a demonstration. No operational support instructions are included.

title: Production change approval FAQ
document_text: A production change requires a recorded change request, risk assessment, implementation plan, test evidence, backout plan, and approval by the appropriate change authority. Emergency changes follow the emergency process.
